Class SysMLFinalState

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLVertex
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLState
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLFinalState
public final class SysMLFinalState extends SysMLState
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML final state of a state machine. The SysMLFinalState extends the SysMLState requiring specification of the context and a name. Transitions to the SysMLFinalState must be declared in the state machine's transition fields and initialized with the SysMLFinalState as the nextState in the state machines createTransitions() method.

Note that transitions out of and within the SysMLState as well as elements such as the onEnterActivity, doActivity, and onExitActivity, are not applicable for the FinalState.
